original: しっかし、暑いなんてもんじゃねえな……
traducao: Man, it's not just hot...

original: 簡単に目玉焼きが作れちまいそうだ
traducao: You could easily fry an egg out here.

original: ……ユーリさんは、料理をするのですか
traducao: ...Do you cook, Yuri?

original: ああ。\nまあ、嗜む程度にはな
traducao: Yeah.\nEnough to get by, at least.

original: これでも、ギルドで生計を立てながら\n自炊してたんだ。\n一通りの料理ならそれなりに作れるぜ
traducao: I lived on my own and cooked while\nearning a living in the guild, you see.\nI can make most basic dishes.

original: すごいです……。\nユーリさんは何でも出来るのですね
traducao: That is impressive...\nYou really can do anything, Yuri.

original: 何でもって事はねえけど……\n必要に迫られりゃ、人間大概の事は\n出来る様になるもんだ
traducao: I wouldn't say anything, but...\nwhen necessity forces your hand,\npeople learn to do most things.

original: すずは何が好物なんだ？
traducao: What kind of food do you like, Suzu?

original: 無事この仕事が片付いたら、\nお疲れ様会ってな感じで\n簡単なもんなら食わせてやるぜ
traducao: Once this job is safely wrapped up,\nas a little celebration,\nI'll whip up something simple for you.

original: ……お気遣い感謝します
traducao: ...Thank you for your consideration.

original: そのお話は、任務達成後に\n追ってまたご相談させて下さい
traducao: Please let us discuss that again\nafter our mission is accomplished.

original: ……では、私はこの先の魔物の様子を\n探ってきますので
traducao: ...Now then, I shall scout ahead\nfor any monsters in our path.

original: 忍びは感情を表に出すべからず……\nってやつか？
traducao: A ninja must never show emotion...\nIs that how it goes?

original: 色々、大変なんだな
traducao: Must be tough on you.

original: しかし、ここの魔物は手強いのが多いな
traducao: Still, the monsters here are pretty tough.

original: さっきの奴なんて、\n結構冷や汗もんだったぜ
traducao: That last one really broke me\ninto quite a cold sweat.

original: そうでしたか？\nとてもそんな風には見えませんでした
traducao: Was that so?\nIt did not look that way at all.

original: そりゃどーも。\nこれでもビビったり\n驚いたりはしてるんだけどな
traducao: Much obliged.\nI still get scared and surprised,\neven if it doesn't show.

original: ……ユーリさんは、\n忍者に向いているかもしれません
traducao: ...You might actually be well-suited\nto be a ninja, Yuri.

original: 忍者に転職するつもりはないのですか？
traducao: Have you ever thought of becoming one?

original: ははっ。\n面白い誘いだが、遠慮しておくよ
traducao: Haha.\nAn intriguing offer, but I'll pass.

original: 誰かに仕えて任務をこなすなんて、\nオレの性分じゃねぇし
traducao: Serving someone and carrying out orders\njust isn't in my nature.

original: そうですか……
traducao: I see...

original: では、気が変わったら\nそうおっしゃって下さい
traducao: Should you ever change your mind,\nplease let me know.

original: ユーリさんでしたら\nいつでも頭領にお引き合わせします
traducao: For someone like you, Yuri,\nI would gladly introduce you to the chief.

original: そりゃ光栄だな。\n気持ちだけ、ありがたく受け取っとくよ
traducao: That's an honor, then.\nI'll happily take the thought.

original: しかし、外の世界ってのは\nこうも複雑で、広くて……。\n色んな人間が暮らしているものなんだねえ
traducao: Still, the outside world really is\nvast and complex...\nWith so many people living in it.

original: はい。\nここで暮らす様になってからしばらくは\n毎日が小さな発見の連続でした
traducao: Yes.\nWhen I first began living here,\nevery day was a series of discoveries.

original: そうだね。\nあたし達の里は、それだけ\n徹底して外との接触を避けてきた
traducao: That's true.\nOur village avoided all contact with\nthe outside world with such strictness.

original: そういう意味じゃ、あたし達が漠然と\n外だと思ってた世界も\n本当の意味で外なんかじゃなかったんだ
traducao: In that sense, what we vaguely\nconsidered the outside world wasn't\ntruly the outside world at all.

original: それを今回、つくづく思い知らされたよ
traducao: This journey really drove that home.

original: 忍びは、掟に従って生きるもの。\n非情でなくては務まらない……
traducao: A ninja must live by the code,\nand remain cold and ruthless...

original: これまではそれが当たり前だったのに\n外はこんなにも豊かで、変化に満ちて\nみんなが泣いて、笑って暮らしている……
traducao: Though we took that for granted,\nthe outside world is rich and varied,\nwith people laughing and crying freely...

original: それがここの「当たり前」なんですね
traducao: That is what is "normal" here.

original: そうだねぇ。ルールや規則はあっても、\nあたし達の掟程厳しいわけじゃないし\nましてや、命に関わる掟もない
traducao: Yeah. There are rules here, but\nthey aren't as harsh as our code,\nand none carry the penalty of death.

original: 今まで普通だと思ってた事が\n普通じゃなくなるってのは\nどうにも妙な感覚だね
traducao: Having what used to feel normal\nsuddenly stop being normal...\nIt really is a strange feeling.

original: だからこそ、知る事が出来たものも\nたくさんあります
traducao: Yet because of that, there is so much\nwe have been able to learn.

original: 皆さんと出会えて\n旅をしたからこそわかった事が
traducao: Things we only understood because\nwe met everyone and traveled together.

original: ああ。\nあたしもそう思うよ
traducao: Yeah.\nI feel the exact same way.

original: それって、多分……\nなかなか体験出来る事じゃないし\nとっても恵まれてるって事……なんだよね
traducao: Experiences like this don't come often,\nso we really are quite blessed...\naren't we?

original: はい
traducao: Yes!

original: お互いに、新しい世界が\n広がったという事なのだと思います。\nきっと……
traducao: I believe a brand new world has\nopened up for both of us.\nI am certain of it...

original: ふぅ……、甲板は気持ちいいですね。\n風が心地いいです
traducao: Phew... The deck is so pleasant.\nThe breeze feels so wonderful.

original: ああ、そうだな。\nすずしいなー
traducao: Yeah, it is.\n"Suzu-Sheena" cool breeze...

original: 何でしょうか？
traducao: Did you need something?

original: どうした？　\n何か用かい？
traducao: What is it?\nDo you need us for something?

original: え？　え？\n何だよ、一体？
traducao: Huh? What?\nWhat is with you two all of a sudden?

original: 今、呼ばれましたので……
traducao: You just called our names...

original: そうだよ。\n名前を呼んだじゃないか
traducao: That's right.\nYou called our names just now.

original: え、いや、ただ、\n「すずしいなー」って……
traducao: Wait, no, I just meant\n"Suzu-Sheena cool breeze"...

original: ですから……
traducao: And so...?

original: 何の用なんだいって？
traducao: What did you want us for?

original: ユーリ、アレですよ。\n最近名前を繋げるのが\n流行っている、例の……
traducao: Yuri, it's that thing, you know?\nThe trend that's going around\nof chaining names together...

original: おいおい、関係ねぇぞ、今。\n誰だよ、広めてるの！
traducao: Whoa, that has nothing to do with this!\nWho is spreading that anyway!?

original: あんたが\n名前をくっ付けて呼び始めた\n張本人なんだろ？
traducao: Aren't you the mastermind who\nstarted combining names and calling\npeople that in the first place?

original: 私も、そう聞きました
traducao: I heard that as well.

original: いやー、それは、\nオレには関係ないっつーか……
traducao: No, look, that has\nnothing to do with me...

original: 何だい！\n用がないなら、\n呼ばないでくれるかい？
traducao: Whatever!\nIf you don't need anything,\ndon't call our names!

original: すず、行くよ！
traducao: Suzu, let's go!

original: …………。\n失礼します
traducao: ......\nExcuse us.

original: 勘弁してくれよ……。\n何で、オレが怒られなきゃ……
traducao: Give me a break...\nWhy am I the one getting yelled at...?

original: 自業自得、です？
traducao: You reaped what you sowed, perhaps?

original: ぼくが聞き及んだ限りでも\nすずは色々な知識に\n精通している様だな……
traducao: From what I've heard,\nyou seem remarkably well-versed\nin all kinds of knowledge, Suzu...

original: どこの大学で学んだんだ？
traducao: Which university did you study at?

original: 大学……？\nいえ、私は教育施設には通っていません
traducao: University...?\nNo, I have never attended school.

original: 何だって？
traducao: What was that?!

original: このぼくですら習得に\n時間がかかる様な難解な知識を、\n独学で得たっていうのか？
traducao: Esoteric knowledge that took even me\ntime to master...\nYou learned all that on your own!?

original: 独学というより、里の頭領に教わりました。\nいつか役立つ事があるかもしれぬ、と
traducao: Less self-taught, more instructed by\nour chief in case it proved useful.

original: 天候変化の科学的根拠や仕組みなんて、\n一般人にはどう役に立つって言うんだ
traducao: How on earth is scientific meteorology\nuseful to an ordinary citizen!?

original: 一般人ではありません。\n私は忍者ですから
traducao: I am not an ordinary citizen.\nI am a ninja.

original: ああ、いや、そういう事が\n言いたかったわけじゃ……
traducao: Ah, no, that wasn't what\nI meant by that...

original: 忍者とはそういうものです。\n厳しい道を乗り越えた者のみが\n本当の忍びになれるのです
traducao: Such is the way of the ninja.\nOnly those who endure harsh trials\ncan become true shinobi.

original: ええと……だから……
traducao: Er... but, you see...

original: 何か疑問点があれば、\n私のわかる範囲でお答えしますが
traducao: If you have any further questions,\nI shall answer to the best of my ability.

original: ……いえ……もういいです……
traducao: ...No... never mind...

original: ……どうやら撒いたみたいだな
traducao: ...Looks like I gave them the slip.

original: へへっ、ここまで来れば\n一安心……
traducao: Heh heh, making it this far\nmeans I'm home free...

original: そうはいきませんよ、ゼロスさん
traducao: I'm afraid not, Zelos.

original: えっ、すずちゃん？
traducao: Wait, Suzu, sweetie?

original: しいなさん、こっちです！
traducao: Sheena, over here!

original: よし、すず。\n準備はいいね！？
traducao: All right, Suzu.\nYou ready!?

original: はい
traducao: Yes!

original: イガグリ流忍法、分身の術！
traducao: Igaguri Ninpo: Clone Arte!

original: お、おい！\nなんだこれ！？
traducao: H-Hey!\nWhat is this!?

original: 自分だけ掃除当番サボろうったって\nそうはいかないんだよ
traducao: You thought you could ditch\ncleaning duty all by yourself!?

original: 規律は遵守してもらいます。\nそれがここの決まりですから
traducao: You must abide by the rules.\nThose are the regulations here.

original: って、マジで完全包囲されてるワケ？
traducao: Wait, am I totally surrounded here!?

original: いくら何でも\nこんなの反則なんじゃねーの？\nちょっと〜〜〜！！
traducao: No matter how you look at it,\nisn't this totally cheating!?\nGive me a break~~~!!

original: うう……まだ舌がピリピリします
traducao: Ugh... my tongue is still tingling.

original: 今日のカレー、\n確かにちょっと辛かったよな
traducao: Today's curry was definitely\na bit on the spicy side.

original: はい……
traducao: Yes...

original: 私の里には\n辛みの強い料理がなかったので\nあれにはなかなか慣れません
traducao: My village had no spicy food,\nso getting used to such heat\nis quite difficult for me.

original: カレーを知らなかったのか？\nそれは人生の半分を損しているな
traducao: You'd never had curry before?\nYou're missing out on half of life!

original: そう……なのですか？
traducao: Is that... really so?

original: ああ。　カレーはとても体にいいんだ。\n効率的に様々な栄養を摂取出来るよう\nあの「ルー」が開発されたんだよ
traducao: Yeah! Curry is great for you.\nThat roux was made to provide lots of\nnutrients in one efficient dish!

original: それは知りませんでした
traducao: I did not know that.

original: カレーライス……。\n不条理に辛い料理なのかと思ったのですが\n実は合理的な食べ物だったのですね
traducao: Curry rice...\nI thought it was absurdly spicy, but\nit is actually a very practical dish.

original: 食べるなら甘口がおすすめだよ。\n俺はいつも甘口なんだ
traducao: I recommend the mild variety!\nI always eat mine mild.

original: あまくち……
traducao: Mild...

original: わかりました。\n覚えておきます
traducao: Understood.\nI shall keep that in mind.

original: しいなさん。\nジェイさんについてなのですが
traducao: Sheena.\nRegarding Mr. Jay...

original: どうしたんだい？\n何か引っかかるのかい
traducao: What is it?\nIs something bothering you?

original: 彼は、信頼しても\nいい人物なのでしょうか
traducao: Is he truly someone\nwe can place our trust in?

original: ……ただの情報屋にしては、\n身のこなしに隙がなさ過ぎます
traducao: ...For a simple information broker,\nhis movements leave zero openings.

original: 確かに……ジェイは身軽だし\n気配を殺して動くのが上手い様だね
traducao: True... Jay is remarkably nimble and\nquite skilled at concealing his presence.

original: あの、思ったのですが\nジェイさんは忍者なのではないでしょうか
traducao: I cannot help wondering...\nCould Jay actually be a ninja?

original: そんな、まさか！
traducao: No way! That's absurd!

original: それが本当なら、ミブナの里以外で\n忍者が隠れ住んでいる場所がある事に\nなっちまうよ
traducao: If that were true, it would mean ninja\nare hiding somewhere other than\nthe village of Mibuna!

original: それはそうなのですが……
traducao: That is true, but...

original: すずの考え過ぎじゃないかい？
traducao: Aren't you just overthinking it, Suzu?

original: ……そうでしょうか……
traducao: ...Could I be...?

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
